# commentary/

## Purpose
Generated commentary on a report pack, held as a DRAFT until a named person approves it. Table `report_commentary`, migrations 611 and 612.

## Caller contract
Called by `pages/api/accounting/commentary/*` under `withAuth`; company always from the session. Consumed on the public side by `share/sharedPackService.ts`, which selects `approved_text` and filters `status = 'approved'`. Every statement here carries `company_id`, including the UPDATEs.

## Main signatures
- `listCommentary(companyId, params) → CommentaryRow[]` — the whole pack, unfiltered. There is no section parameter on the route or the hook; `CommentaryBlock` owns the per-section filter.
- `generateDrafts({ companyId, userId, params, data, replace? }) → { written, skipped }`.
- `approveCommentary(companyId, id, userId, editedText?)` (in `commentaryApprove.ts`, re-exported from the service) / `rejectCommentary(...)` → `CommentaryResult`, failing with `not_found` (404), `empty_draft` (400), `invalid_text` (400), `text_too_long` (400), `commentary_budget_exceeded` (400) or `invalid_state` (409) — the route must not collapse them. `editedText` absent copies `draft_text`; present writes the trimmed text and leaves `draft_text` the machine draft.
- `commentaryCost(texts)`, `MAX_APPROVED_PACK_EMS`, `MAX_UNBUDGETED_CHARS`, `approxCharsLeft`, `normaliseEditedText`, `editedTextProblem` (`commentaryLimits.ts`, client-safe) — the ONE cost function the service, the editor and the tests share. `commentaryApprove.ts` holds `approveCommentary`; `commentaryBudget.ts` the server half (which packs are budgeted, the per-pack lock and pack read); `commentaryRow.ts` the row/result types and the two reads.
- `nextStatus(current, action) → Transition`; `buildDraftSentences(data) → DraftSentence[]`; `buildManagementPackData(companyId, params)`.
- `approveCommentary(..., editedText?, reportKind = 'pack', expectedDraft?)` / `rejectCommentary(..., reportKind = 'pack', expectedDraft?)`: a row of another `report_kind` answers `not_found`. `expectedDraft` (the draft the approver was shown; the variance service always passes it) makes a re-drafted row `invalid_state` and is repeated in the UPDATE on both the plain and the edited path: nobody approves text they never saw. The pack routes never pass a kind, so they cannot reach a variance note.
- Budget variance notes (budgets P5 §3e): `varianceCommentary.ts` `listVarianceNotes(companyId, role, versionId, month)`, `saveVarianceNote(companyId, {userId, role}, {versionId, month, glAccountId, cc1Id, cc2Id, buId, text})`, `approveVarianceNote(companyId, actor, id, seenDraft, editedText?)`, `rejectVarianceNote(companyId, actor, id, seenDraft)` → `{ok, note}` or a failure code (`forbidden` 403, `not_found` 404, `bad_request`/`empty_draft`/`invalid_text`/`text_too_long` 400, `invalid_state` 409); `listApprovedVarianceNotes(companyId, versionId, months)` (the management pack). `varianceNoteScope.ts` checks every id is the company's; `varianceNoteTypes.ts` (import-free, client-safe) holds the row key and the role rules.

## Business rules
- **Status machine** (`commentaryState.ts` is the only place a status changes): `draft → approved` (approve), `draft → rejected` (reject), `* → draft` (generate). `generate` on an approved row FAILS.
- **The `replace` gate.** `replace: true` is the only path that re-drafts a row a person already ruled on: it withdraws an approval and revives a rejection. Without it both are left alone and reported in `skipped` — a discarded sentence does not come back because somebody pressed Generate again. The route restricts `replace` to owner/admin; `CommentaryPanel` puts an explicit, single-use confirmation in front of it.
- A withdrawal is STAMPED, not erased: `withdrawn_by`/`withdrawn_at` are set and `approved_text`/`approved_by`/`approved_at` survive, so the row still says who signed off. Nothing leaks — the published query filters on status.
- The `ON CONFLICT ... DO UPDATE ... WHERE` repeats the decision at the write, on the row's state at write time, because another session can approve or reject inside the read-to-write window.
- An empty or whitespace-only draft is never approvable. The 611 CHECK would store the blank.
- Approval writes status, text, approver and timestamp in ONE statement so the CHECK never sees a half-approved row; the WHERE repeats the guard so two racing approvals cannot both write.
- The draft builder never writes `approved_text`. Nothing generated reaches a share link without a person.

- **Variance notes** (`report_kind = 'budget_variance'`): `params_hash = sha256('bva|'||version_id||'|'||'YYYY-MM')` (`reports/varianceParamsHash.ts`, server-only), `period_start/end` the month's bounds, `section_ref = 'account'`, `row_ref = gl_account_id|cc1|cc2|bu` ('' for none, ids lower-cased). Save refuses Login-as first (`assertNotImpersonating`, as approve/reject); approve/reject UPDATEs repeat `report_kind`. Human text → `draft_text`, `generated_by = 'human:<uid>'`, checked by `editedTextProblem` and `MAX_UNBUDGETED_CHARS`. Writers owner/admin/manager (`mayWriteVarianceNote(role, slice)`: the hook for P5-6's budget holders, who write their own slice only); approve/reject owner/admin. An approved note is re-drafted by an approver only (approval stamped withdrawn), a manager gets 409; a rejected one is revived by a save. Drafts are listed to `canReadSharingSurface` roles only. Version, month (inside the version's year), account (revenue/expense) and dims (`resolveTrackingFilter`) are the company's or `not_found`.
- **Reader census (`report_kind`)**: `listCommentary`, `generateDrafts`, `packDraftState` (page 4), `sharedPackService.loadApprovedCommentary` and the list route read `'pack'` only; `approveCommentary`/`rejectCommentary` serve the caller's kind; `lockAndReadPack` reads the row's own kind and is reached only for a pack row (`printsOnFixedPage` is false for any other kind); the variance service reads `'budget_variance'` only. Proved by `budgets-p5-variance-{notes,pack,routes}.int.test.ts` (share link and page 4 drop a variance row even under the pack's own hash).
